Authoritative interpretation of immutable origin, blind and exposed records.
Status: internally proved and adversarially audited. No external mathematical

1. Main theorem and precise quantifiers

For every finite-dimensional faithful density sigma and every positive
sigma-stationary KMS-symmetric quantum Markov generator L, let
Gamma(X)=sqrt(sigma)Xsqrt(sigma), H=Gamma^(1/2)L Gamma^(-1/2).
For every finite untouched reference R and every faithful joint density rho,

 J_R(rho)=Tr[(id_R tensor L_*)rho(logrho-I_R tensor logsigma)]
       >=pi E_R(rho),
 E_R(rho)=Tr[sqrtrho(id_R tensor H)sqrtrho].

The exact same constant is independent of both dimensions, all eigenvalue
ratios, spectral gap and reference marginal. No GNS/modular covariance,
commuting root/log blocks, primitivity, self-compatibility, EB structure or
information budget is a premise. A faithful product reference tau_R tensor
sigma cancels from both forms. The all-finite theorem applies to every joint
state in its natural extended-real sense by the reviewed singular-input ray.
Stationary sigma must remain faithful. Infinite-dimensional dynamics are not
included.

For each real k>pi there exist a finite dimension, faithful sigma, faithful
rho and a primitive legal KMS generator with E(rho)>0 and J(rho)<kE(rho).
Thus pi is the SHARP universal finite constant, also in the complete class.
This does not identify the optimum at fixed qubit dimension.
